channel.title: The Greymouth Star - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Greymouth Star (greystar.co.nz)

item.title: $5 million comes to the Coast - Greymouth Star
item.description: A Greymouth Lotto player had a Valentines Day to remember after waking up yesterday $5.08 million richer, sharing the $15 million Powerball jackpot.

item.title: Proposal to close Quay for new library green space - Greymouth Star
item.description: The Grey District Council is proposing to permanently transform part of Richmond Quay into a pedestrian mall in front of the new Greymouth Library by closing part of the street. PICTURE: Grey District Council

item.title: Coast booked out for Year of the Horse - Greymouth Star
item.description: Chinese New Year has delivered a second wave of summer tourism to the West Coast, with accommodation booked out, rental cars snapped up and tour buses rolling.

item.title: New kiwi chick welcomed to Paparoa - Greymouth Star
item.description: Cousins Harlow O’Connor, of Moonlight, and Stella Loveridge, of Ngahere, were captivated looking at the new kiwi chick Mawhero during an open day with the Paparoa Wildlife Trust at the Atarau Kiwi Sanctuary on Saturday PICTURE: Lynne Berry

item.title: Kings crowned T20 champs - Greymouth Star
item.description: Kings have secured a long-awaited West Coast senior T20 title, producing a measured yet determined performance to defeat Got the Runs on Saturday at Arthur Fong Park, in Greymouth. PICTURE: Bill Phillips, DiGiSPORT

item.title: New roof caps Sallies makeover - Greymouth Star
item.description: Accurate Roofing director Mike Carr outside the Salvation Army church and hall in Shakespeare Street, Greymouth, during a major project to replace the roof of the historic building.

item.title: Coast Iranian draws hope from war - Greymouth Star
item.description: For Nas White, an Iranian-born resident of Kumara, the recent Israeli and US strikes on Iran have stirred a mix of relief, fear, and reflection on decades of family persecution.

item.title: Ocean search widened - Greymouth Star
item.description: An aerial search continues today in rough sea conditions for a kayaker believed to have been swept out to the sea off Blaketown on Saturday evening. PICTURE: Dwayne Detlaff

item.title: Tables stripped from pub - Greymouth Star
item.description: A small West Coast pub has sparked a social media storm after two outdoor tables were removed over licensing rules, infuriating Blackball locals.

item.title: Library fitout advances - Greymouth Star
item.description: Greymouth’s new library development is entering its final stages of construction, with interior fitout under way and Unichem Olsen’s Pharmacy confirmed as the first commercial tenant, with opening planned for mid-June.
